name: Ninja vs Knights
author: Mr.Rafael
description: A platformer where a ninja takes on knights: slash knights, bombs and statues with your sword. Left/right to move, X to jump (hold for higher), Z to attack.

descriptions.en: A platformer where a ninja takes on knights: slash knights, bombs and statues with your sword. Left/right to move, X to jump (hold for higher), Z to attack.
descriptions.it: Un platform in cui un ninja sfida i cavalieri: colpisci cavalieri, bombe e statue con la spada. Sinistra/destra per muoverti, X per saltare (tieni premuto), Z per attaccare.
